subject: SolaraIO connector fit assessment, SDK adaptations & milestones
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@solaraio.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@solaraio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SolaraIO discovery — quick consolidation and next steps

Hi Elena / Raj — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick consolidated notes while it’s fresh, plus proposed next steps. Please flag anything I misunderstood.

Summary of pain & goals (as we understood it)
- Primary pain: search + recommendations returning low-relevance results under load; UX shows relevance regressions during peak query times.
- Goal: deliver a 1) semantic search pipeline with embeddings + reranker, and 2) a conversational assistant for ops staff with streaming responses and ability to call internal runbooks (tooling).
- Constraints: much of SolaraIO’s data lives on-prem and behind a strict VPC; sensitive telemetry and PII redaction requirements; target p50 latency for user queries ~200–300ms (end-to-end on queries you control).

Product fit notes
- Embeddings: want to index historical logs + KB; likely need 1536-d vector (you use older Open embedding dims today) — compatibility check required.
- Reranking: prefer a light, low-cost reranker for production; can do heavier re-rank in async jobs for offline insights.
- Streaming & function-calling: chat assistant should stream partial answers and support function-calls to trigger runbooks or create incident tickets (Webhooks / API).
- Private deployment: you asked about a Redwood Private VPC option and KMS integration for keys — we can support both.

Initial asks from Redwood (to prepare technical deep-dive)
1) A small sample dataset (200–500 search queries + expected golden results) — anonymized.
2) Short network diagram (eg. where inference would sit relative to SolaraIO prod VPC).
3) Any compliance docs that must be met early (SOC2 evidence, retention windows).

Attachments: [Attachment: discovery-notes-20270507.txt]

Proposed immediate next steps
- Ben to draft a rough MVP scope and initial cost estimate (includes SDK change requests and a 6-week PoC plan) — by Tue, 2027-05-11.
- Technical deep-dive (Ben + Karthik + Solara engineering) — propose Wed, 2027-05-12 10:00 AM PT (please confirm).
- Solara to share sample queries + network diagram by Mon, 2027-05-10.

I’ll track these as action items and follow up once Ben posts the initial scope.

Thanks — Camila

Thanks Camila — this matches our notes. A few clarifications from our end: 

- Latency target: our expectation is 200–300ms p50 for the search API when the request hits our edge (we understand some infra components add overhead). If the reranker is heavier, we want fallback to a cheaper model to keep SLAs.
- Data sensitivity: the KB contains customer PII in some entries — we need automatic redaction in any logs sent out. We cannot allow raw telemetry to leave our VPC without scrubbing.
- On-prem nuance: we have a hybrid setup — some logs live on-prem, but we can route embeddings to a private Redwood deployment if needed.

I attached our high-level compliance summary that the security team wants referenced early.

Attachments: [Attachment: solara-privacy-requirements.pdf]

Happy to confirm Wed 05/12 10:00 AM PT for the technical deep-dive — that works for our engineering lead (Raj) and me.

Elena

Subject: Re: SolaraIO discovery — quick consolidation and next steps

Elena / Raj — thanks for confirming. High-level technical assessment and how we’d approach an MVP / PoC: 

MVP scope (6-week PoC) — goals
- End-to-end semantic search: new embeddings pipeline + index, lightweight production reranker that improves top-5 relevance.
- Chat assistant prototype: streaming responses + function-calling hooks to trigger internal runbook endpoints.

SDK/runtime changes we recommend
- Streaming: implement chunked chunk/partial token streaming in our SDK; will require minor client-side change to reassemble tokens and render progressively.
- Function-calling: we’ll add a secure function-call interface in the SDK supporting signed webhooks and a small JSON schema registry for runbook actions.
- Structured outputs: define a JSON schema for assistant responses with a recommended validation layer to avoid schema drift (we’ll propose a draft).
- Embeddings compatibility: our recommended embedding vector dimension for this workload is 1536; if SolaraIO already uses 1024 dims, we’ll provide a migration compatibility layer and conversion guidance.

Operational considerations
- Private deployment: Redwood Private with KMS + VPC peering is feasible; we’ll need a network diagram and port access list.
- Latency: to meet 200–300ms p50 we’ll recommend a deduped prefix cache and an initial quantized model variant for rerank. Fallback policy: cheap reranker variant when load spikes.

Deliverables and owners
- Ben: initial cost + timeline estimate (spreadsheet attached) — due Tue 2027-05-11. [Attachment: initial-estimate-embed-rerank.xlsx]
- Karthik: will lead the technical deep-dive and propose concrete SDK method signatures and JSON schema for function-calls — Wed 2027-05-12 meeting.
- Solara: sample queries + network diagram by Mon 2027-05-10.

Risks / open questions
- What SLAs do you need for retry vs fallback behavior?
- Any internal policy that forbids running any inference outside the on-prem boundary (even for caching)?

If the above looks good I’ll prepare a short technical note for the meeting and a draft SDK spec for review.

Ben
